## ad-versions errors
Set as the error workflow of **ad-versions**. For now: writes `runs/<id>/error.json` (node, message, time) and stops. The failing execution's id is the run id; a failure in the trigger itself has none and gets `trigger-<timestamp>`.

**Later (12b):** delete any GPU pod the run started, then a Telegram message on the demo bot (credential `telegram-demo`) with the failing node's name.
